description: Shared fixture corpus for planning a shell switch: the C# engine (ShellSwitchPlanner) and the TypeScript engine (planShellSwitch) must produce identical plans. Each case resolves currentRoot and candidateRoot against the library, then plans the switch for the screens with the user's remaps.

cases.name: same shell
cases.description: switching to the shell already in place changes nothing

moves.description: Outlet 'sidebar' is kept; no screen uses it
'Orders' and 'Customers' stay in outlet 'content'

cases.name: same outlet names
cases.description: a shell with the same outlets keeps every screen where it is

moves.description: 'Menu' stays in outlet 'sidebar'
'Orders' stays in outlet 'content'

cases.name: content follows the primary outlet
cases.description: content moves to the primary outlet of a shell that names it differently

moves.description: Outlet 'sidebar' of shell 'OwnShell' has no counterpart in shell 'OwnFrame'; no screen uses it
'Orders', 'Customers' and 'Tickets' move from outlet 'content' to 'main', the primary outlet of shell 'OwnFrame'

cases.name: primary follows back
cases.description: the primary outlet of the current shell goes to the content outlet of the next

moves.description: Outlet 'nav' of shell 'OwnFrame' has no counterpart in shell 'OwnShell'; no screen uses it
'Orders' moves from outlet 'main' to 'content', the primary outlet of shell 'OwnShell'

cases.name: primary of a blueprint root template
cases.description: a blueprint root screen template with its own primary outlet

moves.description: Outlet 'sidebar' of shell 'OwnShell' has no counterpart in shell 'AnalyticsRoot'; no screen uses it
'Orders' moves from outlet 'content' to 'main', the primary outlet of shell 'AnalyticsRoot'

cases.name: unused outlet without counterpart
cases.description: an outlet nobody uses needs no decision

moves.description: Outlet 'sidebar' is kept; no screen uses it
Outlet 'subject' of shell 'ToolShell' has no counterpart in shell 'OwnShell'; no screen uses it

cases.name: used outlet without counterpart
cases.description: screens in an outlet the new shell lacks block the switch until decided

3 screens ('Customers', 'Tickets' and 'Invoices') place content in outlet 'subject', which shell 'OwnShell' does not have: move it into 'content', map it to another outlet or drop it
'Orders' stays in outlet 'content'
